bullets.title: V: Strong Q4 beat, FY27 guided low-double-digit growth; PTs raised to $440-466
bullets.body: Visa Q4 EPS $3.48 beat ($3.44 est), revenue $12.14B slightly ahead; payment volume +9.3%, cross-border +14%, VAS revenue +31%. FY27 guided low-double-digit net revenue growth and low-teens EPS growth, with ~25% of payment volume up for renewal (vs 20% in FY26) creating incentive headwind. Goldman raises PT to $455, RBC to $466, Citi to $440; sell-side 88% Buy with avg PT up 3.1% to $443.

bullets.title: GEV: Strong beat/raise, $9B Trench acquisition, buyback doubled to $20B
bullets.body: GEV Q3 non-GAAP EPS $4.16 beat $4.03 est; revenue $12.64B beat $11.99B est. Raised FY26 guidance: adj EBITDA margin 13.5%-14.5%, revenue $46.5B-$47.5B, FCF $16B-$17B. Acquired Trench Group for $9B (13x '28 EBITDA); orders $29B +96% organically. Power EBITDA margin 21.4% vs 19% buyside; backlog expected to exceed $200B in Q4. Buyback authorization doubled from $10B to $20B.

bullets.title: VRT: +55% organic growth in Q3, guides Q4 +50%; stock surges ~17% pre-market
bullets.body: Vertiv delivered 55% organic growth in Q3 versus a 40% buyside bogey, with EPS beat +2%. Q4 guided at +50% organic growth; organic orders exceed 100% with expanding global pipeline. Pre-market +16.9%; Morgan Stanley and Oppenheimer both flag this bodes well for MOD, FPS, and the broader AI infrastructure complex.

bullets.title: ENPH: Q4 guide -20% below consensus; downgraded at multiple firms, stock -20%
bullets.body: ENPH Q3 EPS $0.41 missed $0.51 est; Q4 guidance $225M-$255M vs $297.6M consensus — a ~20% miss at midpoint. Gross margin guided 40%-43% vs 44% consensus; no meaningful US demand recovery signaled. Europe sell-through declined 12% in Q3. Downgraded to Perform at Oppenheimer and to Neutral at Roth (PT cut to $30 from $55). Sympathy weakness in SEDG -9.9%, RUN -5.2%.

bullets.title: ETSY: Q3 beat across board; active buyers grow y/y for first time in 2 years; stock +6-7%
bullets.body: ETSY Q3 revenue $692.5M vs $668.1M est, GMS $2.65B vs $2.57B, adj EBITDA $210.4M vs $195.9M. Q4 GMS guided +5-7% y/y; FY26 GMS guidance raised to ~7% with 30% adj EBITDA margin. AI/ML personalization contributed ~2ppts to annualized GMS growth; active buyers growing y/y for first time in 2 years. CFO Lanny Baker departing March 1.

bullets.title: STX: Clean beat/raise; GIR '28 EPS +15% to ~$68.60; downgraded at Summit Insights
bullets.body: Seagate delivered a beat/raise with Goldman raising '28 EPS estimates ~15% to ~$68.60; HAMR expected to be ~70% of shipments in CY27 with significant buyback acceleration starting CY27. Nearline shipments +2% q/q to record 198EB. Summit Insights downgraded to Hold citing moderating outperformance through 2027. Stock -2.5% pre-market vs. the positive underlying print, reflecting mixed read-through from Mozaic 4 transition timing.

bullets.title: APP: Hedgeye and Citi both short — model deceleration post-games sale, Q3 guide slowing sharply
bullets.body: APP missed its 2Q26 revenue guide midpoint for the first time in 15 quarters; Street cut FY28 EBITDA by 12%. Q3 sequential growth guided at 7.6% vs 17.5% in 3Q24. Net revenue per install growth decelerated to 58% from 93%; AXON improvement rate slowing after removal of first-party games data. APP reports November 4.

bullets.title: U (Unity): Hedgeye long — Vector ad-tech upgrade driving budget shifts from APP
bullets.body: Unity's Vector grew 23% sequentially vs internal plan of 12-13%; advertiser count up 37% since early July vs 10% for APP. Primary research shows 3 of 4 Unity buyers report better returns vs APP; one shifted ~10% of spend. Vector passed $1B+ annual run rate two quarters early. Commerce product live June 30; model projects $1.6B spending routed through it in 2028. Unity reports November 5.

bullets.title: AMZN: F3Q26 preview — Street expects $202.2B rev, 37.8% AWS growth; capex $220B FY26
bullets.body: Consensus expects F3Q26 revenue $202.22B (above $202B guidance high), AWS at $45.5B (+37.8% y/y vs +36.8% last quarter), operating margin 13.0% vs 12.3% guidance midpoint, EPS $1.97. Key focus on AWS acceleration from OpenAI partnership, Trainium/Bedrock adoption, and agentic AI strategy. FY26 capex guided $220B; FY27 capex consensus $280.8B. Hedgeye sees 30% upside over 12-15 months.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Cloud +100% y/y expected in 3Q; OpenAI buying TPUs; CFO signals capex up significantly in 2027
bullets.body: Goldman notes GOOGL expects Cloud revenue +100% y/y in Q3; OpenAI plans to buy GOOGL TPUs, deepening partnership and contributing meaningfully to Cloud revenues. CFO signaled capex will increase significantly in 2027. ORCL also deploying TPU 8t/8i in CY27, diversifying away from NVDA. GS hosting internet earnings recap webinar Friday 10/30.

bullets.title: META: Explicit Hedgeye short; $97.5B capital raise ($60B ATM); Muse AI expanding with NVDA/AMD investments
bullets.body: Hedgeye's McCullough has META as explicit short based on signal model. Separately, META is expanding its Muse AI partnership with a $3B NVDA investment and $1B AMD investment, and deploying additional Vera Rubin/Vera CPUs. META also raising $97.5B ($60B via ATM starting January). MS TMT notes META international Muse launches as incremental positive.

bullets.title: MSFT: Jefferies HQ visit Nov 12 focused on AI/Copilot; voluntary exit packages to ~60K employees
bullets.body: Jefferies hosting MSFT HQ visit Nov 12 with CVP/CFO-level management focused on AI strategy, Copilot, ChatGPT integration, and cloud resource management. Separately, 22V notes MSFT offering voluntary exit packages to ~60,000 employees (27% of workforce) while reporting record $332B revenue (+18%) and 21% operating income growth — cited as illustration of AI-driven labor efficiency.

bullets.title: FOXA: Q1 earnings preview Nov 2; consensus $4.32B revenue, $2.08 EPS; Citi's top-ranked media stock
bullets.body: FOXA reports Q1 before market open November 2. FactSet consensus: $4.32B revenue, $2.08 EPS, $1.36B EBITDA. Stock +8.3% since early August vs S&P +0.2%; beat rate 17 of last 20 quarters on both revenue and EPS. Citi ranks Fox as its top-ranked media stock; Roku acquisition expected to close 1Q27 and be accretive to FCF in year one. Short interest elevated at 24%; options pricing ~8.3% post-earnings move.

bullets.title: PINS: Q3 earnings preview Oct 29 after close; consensus $1.21B revenue, 656M MAUs; options imply ~11.7% move
bullets.body: Pinterest reports Q3 after close Thursday. Revenue consensus $1.21B vs guidance $1.19-1.21B; adj EBITDA $348M vs guidance $335-355M; MAU 656M, ARPU $1.85. Stock +19.6% since Aug 4. Beat rate 16 of 20 quarters on revenue; options imply ~11.7% move.

bullets.title: DASH/FWONK: Unusual options activity ahead of earnings (363%/241% above avg volume)
bullets.body: DoorDash showing 363% above-average options volume (32,014 vs 8,815 avg) with 0.02 P/C ratio ahead of Nov-04 earnings. Formula One (FWONK) at 241% above-average options volume (4,422 vs 1,837 avg) ahead of Nov-05 earnings. Both readings indicate heavily skewed call positioning.

bullets.title: NOW: Hedgeye adds to bullish Signal Strength list; TEAM top long performer (+105% over 83 days)
bullets.body: Hedgeye added ServiceNow (NOW) to its 54-stock bullish Signal Strength portfolio as of 10/28. TEAM remains the top-performing long at +105.31% over 83 days. Citi TMT also notes NOW in the context of AI infrastructure beneficiaries.

bullets.title: CLS: PT raised to $436 on 17x P/E; FY27 sales outlook $40B (+90% y/y)
bullets.body: Citi raises Celestica PT to $436 (17x target P/E); FY27 sales outlook raised to $40B, +90% y/y, with FY27 operating margin of 9.0%. AI infrastructure demand surge is the primary driver. Stock +4-6.7% pre-market in sympathy with VRT earnings.

bullets.title: AAPL: iPhone 18 Pro series global sales +3.1% vs iPhone 17; China +29% y/y
bullets.body: MS TMT notes Apple iPhone 18 Pro series global sales tracking +3.1% vs iPhone 17 at comparable period; China up 29% y/y. Hedgeye flags AAPL as a midterm election policy consideration (AI regulation, data centers).

bullets.title: NXPI: Q3 beat but weak Q4 guide; auto restocking limited; stock revisiting lows at 10x '28 P/E
bullets.body: NXPI Q3 EPS beat +1.9%, revenue +0.8%, gross margin +20bps, but Q4 revenue guided 0.3% below consensus. Auto grew +7% q/q with limited restocking; China EV subsidy sunset flagged as FY27 headwind. Data center exposure only ~4% of 2026 revenues. Board authorized $5B buyback; stock at 10x '28 P/E with $5B repurchase program (~10% of shares) but analysts see limited near-term EPS revision catalyst. PT range: $175-$466 reflects wide analyst dispersion.

bullets.title: RBLX: Upcoming earnings focus on user aging and bookings per user; survey data available
bullets.body: Roth Capital offering proprietary survey (n=1,000) tracking whether Roblox is aging up users and growing bookings per user, including migration to competing platforms (Fortnite, Minecraft). Goldman's internet earnings recap webinar Friday 10/30 will also address RBLX. No directional view provided in these items.
